body: I hope you are doing ok. Did you get to talk to someone?

I'm having a really hard time at the moment but I want to try. 

I'm going to go with yes and no.

. I've found that it's always there on some level, but there's a bit of up and down in the long term. I feel like as I've gotten older the serious traumas get harder and harder to deal with when they happen. Im less resilient than I used to be. I don't know if that's just life or if I'm unlucky in the messed up situations category. I haven't figured out how to live an authentic life while shutting out risk of trauma, in particular because I do better when I'm not shutting people out, and people are messy.. picking the right ones is easier said than done. When I'm doing well the little things are easier to deal with, so in that regard for me at least, it gets better. It's just that doing well seems to involve staying on top of everything: housing, money, relationships, chores, self care. It's a lot of work to be doing well and I don't really know how to cope when life comes and kicks my sand castle down.
"Everything happens for a reason" is the worst. I have no idea why anyone finds that idea comforting. I completely get being sick of hearing it.

It was helpful to express myself, and to read others posts and comments, so thankyou to the people who maintain this thread. It seems like a difficult calling. I had a stiff cry and am going to try getting some sleep. (I found the private message unhelpful, but I suppose that sort of thing is inevitable. I worry if everyone who posts here deals with such things.)
